x402-revenue.why: This sensor's alert means first dollar received, a one-time good event, not a fault.

x402_distribution.why: Reports newly found buyers; news, not a fault.

trends.why: Digest of metric movements; each real fault has its own sensor.

auto_seed_liveness.why: claude-code is seeding; the hermes plugin has no writes on record, so it isn't a lost source.

kalshi-edge-health.why: A kanban board stopped since August; Kalshi work now runs in the kalshi chain, reported by loop-kalshi and kalshi_maker_paper.

capability_scan.why: Runs weekly, so the board's 48-hour stale limit doesn't fit it.

sentinel_adversarial.why: Runs on a multi-day schedule, so the board's 48-hour stale limit doesn't fit it.
